sources.entry: Yomu - Manga reader app for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Yomu is a manga reader app for macOS, with keyboard navigation for browsing chapters.
summary.what_it_does: Yomu is a manga reader for Mac OS, distributed as a Yomu.pkg installer or built from source with make package. The README describes keyboard navigation on the chapter collection view: h and l go to the previous and next chapter, and j and k scroll down and up. The README says content is provided by Manga Eden and that the author does not host it. It lists a set of Swift libraries used by the app, including RxSwift, Realm, Moya, Argo and Cartography. The README gives no further feature details.
use_cases: Browsing manga chapters with keyboard shortcuts
Studying a Swift macOS app built with RxSwift and Realm
how_to_run: Open the directory and double-click Yomu.pkg to install
notable: Keyboard-driven chapter navigation (h, j, k, l)
Built with a set of functional Swift libraries such as Swiftz and Curry
Distributed as a macOS installer package
caveats: Content comes from Manga Eden, which the author does not host
Built as a hobby project; the README gives no maintenance or support commitment
